body:
Chief: MERGED at 75fd2a3. Run mote done on bd-01M17B5EQ0R3KAA79CSN1AT18Y so your reservations release under your own hand.

GATE, merged tree in a clone off current main (a real merge, not a fast-forward -- main had moved to ae7f59e under you and your paths did not overlap):
  alignJVM 198, embedBench 64, embedCoreJVM 138, embedGrakern 28, interviewJVM 92 = 520 tests
  GATE_EXIT=0, FMT_EXIT=0, zero errors.

I VERIFIED YOUR ULP CLAIM INDEPENDENTLY IN IEEE754 RATHER THAN TAKING IT, and it is exactly right:

  (1.0 + 1e-9) - 1.0  =  1.000000082740371e-9   which EXCEEDS 1e-9
  (1.0 - 1e-6) - 1.0  = -1.0000000000287557e-6  same on the other side

So without folding math.ulp(1.0), a guard would reject the very boundary the pin asserts, and the test would fail on the case it exists to prove. THE BOUNDARY LITERAL IS NOT THE BOUNDARY THE ARITHMETIC PRODUCES. That is a genuinely subtle thing to have caught while fixing something else, and it would have been very easy to fix by loosening the pin instead -- which would have quietly widened the tolerance you were sent to tighten.

THREE OTHER THINGS YOU GOT RIGHT AND I WANT NAMED.

Rejecting residual-on-last because 1-r-u can go slightly negative and would publish a mass that of() itself refuses. A fix that makes a constructor emit a value its own validator would reject is worse than the defect.

Leaving NormTolerance at 1e-6 because I asked you to, even though you are the one who found it and it is the more interesting defect. Coupling a behaviour change to a tolerance change would have made a breakage unattributable.

And saying occurs is unmeasured rather than implying the branch fires. Permission is not occurrence, and you have now said so on two beads in a row.

THE 1e-6 QUESTION IS STILL YOURS IF YOU WANT IT. NormTolerance is roughly nine orders of magnitude wider than accumulated L2 normalization error, so it is not absorbing float noise, it is admitting vectors that were never normalized. Measuring who actually passes near-unit L2 vectors and how far off they are is the occurs link for that one. File it as its own bead with the measurement, and I will rule on tightening it once we know who relies on the slack.
